correctness.rationale: For integer translations and half-integer modulations the scalar Zak frame multiplier is |Zg_c(x,w)|^2+|Zg_c(x,w+1/2)|^2. The exact full zero-set of the odd unperturbed window from the inspected October 26 primary theorem yields exactly the common zeros (0,0),(0,1/2). First-order real spatial vectors d and imaginary frequency vectors b are nondegenerate; the even perturbation vector h enters independently in both, so minimizing the local quadratic fibre energy gives C_R=(h0*d1-h1*d0)^2/(d0^2+d1^2)=0.267745213797... and C_I=(h0*b1-h1*b0)^2/(b0^2+b1^2)=0.0169530120582..., both positive. Independently computed these exact-formula coefficients and ratio ~15.793. Compactness and local Hessian bounds force all small-c global minimizers into O(|c|) neighborhoods, establishing phase-uniform little-oh rather than numerical-only proof; no global claim for large perturbation.
